descriptionHtml:
Bug B11 · P1 · new

Text typed in a Quick Dictation box is lost without warning if the page reloads or closes within ~0.8 s

Tickets: TFA-92582 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S21 Reload or close the tab within the 800 ms autosave window: the last words are not dropped (scripted)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 An unassigned box stays on the pad after Quick Dictation is closed and reopened, as the physician's own log. Boxes are never silently dropped. (The UAT says 'stays on the sheet'; … (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 5; TFA-92582 step 5; TFA-92583 AC 4)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Standard fixture; pad open with one empty box

When Fill the box with 'Bed 12, daughter updated, plan unchanged.' and call page.reload() with no wait; reopen the pad. Then replace the whole text with 'Bed 12, daughter updated, plan unchanged. Call back at 5.', call page.close() at once, open context.newPage() on the Hospital list and open the pad

Then The box still holds the full text, or the app says plainly that the last words were not saved

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: after the reload the box holds 'Bed 12, daughter updated, plan unchanged.'; in the new tab it holds 'Bed 12, daughter updated, plan unchanged. Call back at 5.' (U4: never silently dropped). A visible 'not saved' message instead is recorded for Daniela. …

Where it ran: local newspec-b (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92582 ready for qa; TFA-92583 ready for qa

Text typed into a Quick Dictation box is lost without warning if the physician reloads or closes the tab within about a second of typing.

Evidence: newspec-b, reproduced twice. After a reload the box is empty and the server row is ''. After closing the tab, only the older sentence is left. No 'not saved' message appears. Cause: useQuickDictation's 800 ms debounce, with no flush on unload and no device draft. Breaks TC-04 U4 'never silently dropped'. Only predicted in the TC-04 risks; not in the dev report or ledger.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-b.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (page.reload with no wait, page.close)) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-b.

UAT item: TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-04/S21

Reload or close the tab within the 800 ms autosave window: the last words are not dropped (scripted)

Tickets: TFA-92582 Quick Dictation (ready for qa); TFA-92583 Rounding Sheet (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-b: status failed in newspec-b/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (newspec-b/plan.json, automatable: yes): Chromium spec: fill the pad box, page.reload() with no wait, reopen pad, assert full text; replace text, page.close() at once, context.newPage() on /rounding, open pad, assert the longer text. A visible 'not saved' message is recorded instead of failing. — Scripted reload/close within the 800 ms autosave debounce is a plain Playwright action.

Detail:

Reproduced twice. Reload with no wait after typing 'Bed 12, daughter updated, plan unchanged.': on reopening the box is empty and the server row is ''. Replacing it with '... Call back at 5.' and closing the tab at once: the new tab shows only the old sentence. No 'not saved' message either time.

Product issue: A physician who types into a Quick Dictation box and reloads or closes the tab within ~0.8 s loses the last words with no warning: the box comes back empty (or without 'Call back at 5.'). Breaks TC-04 U4 ('boxes are never silently dropped'). On main the pad saves on an 800 ms debounce (useQuickDictation) with no flush on unload and no device draft.

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
